name: Details
purpose: Progressive disclosure — native <details>/<summary>. Link-coloured summary with arrow marker; open content carries a 10px grey left border (decorative).

accessibility.focus: summary gets yellow-fill focus (background+text swap), matching links
accessibility.notes: left border is DECORATIVE — #CECECE on white is 1.63:1 and intentionally NOT a gated pair (1.4.11 exemption); disclosure state is carried by the native marker + open attribute, not the border

antiPatterns: relying on the grey border to signal state
